change: The chat collector snapshots primary, fallback chain and temperature into its exclusive output directory before invoking any child. Each child reads that snapshot; edits to the source manifest do not alter later samples.

initial.finding: After the injected manifest edit, 29 later child invocations read a different primary.

running_cohort.note: This already-running cohort uses the manually created snapshot; the collector change applies to future invocations only.
